assumptions.axes: History fixes10rooms and scales retainedrows/room100×scale; registry scales10rooms×scale with100retainedrows/room. Each has1000×scale total retainedrows.
assumptions.rosters: Half DM two human owners; half groups owner+six human peers+one agent. One synthetic owner belongs to every room (intentional unbounded registry stress),7users total.
assumptions.payload: 65-byte opaque synthetic blobs and synthetic checkpoints, not valid Loro. SQL-only, not CRDT or HTTP/native integration.
assumptions.proportions: Declared deterministic assumptions; no production measurements available. Project/chat registries are related by owner but independent chat IDs.
assumptions.cache: Warm single-reader local SQLite; no writers, network, relay mutex wait or device rendering.
assumptions.rows_read: Actual summed SQLite NVISIT loop counters across executed source SELECTs; logical visits, not physical disk reads. VM steps separately reported.
